text:
I have visited this branch multiple times, usually on weekends, and have consistently received good service. I always order takeaway, typically bringing the food home by bicycle. I usually order one large drink and two or three small ones, and until now, the staff have always packed the large drink separately and grouped the small ones together, which made it easy and safe to carry.

However, this morning (Thursday), I visited during breakfast hours for the first time and was extremely disappointed. The large and small drinks were all packed together in a single bag without proper care. On my way home, one of the small drink lids came off inside the bag, spilling the drink all over my hands, feet, and even my face. This was not only messy but completely ruined my morning before I could even eat.

I don’t know whether this happened because the staff was careless or because they were not properly trained, but either way, it’s unacceptable. I hope management seriously looks into this and ensures that proper packing procedures are followed in the future. I never want to go through something like this again.
author: 강예준

text:
Not sure how this Mcdonald's outlet has 4.1 stars? 🤔
This has always been the worst one. Once, a staff dropped ice cream on my shoes.
This time, my McSpicy was quite.. overfried. It was 30% crust at least, and quite flat.
Tried to get a replacement. They did replace.. HOWEVER, they refused to give me my cheese which they also tossed along with the original burger. I can't remember exactly what explanation they used.
I had paid for extra cheese too.
After a while, they decided to be nice and give me what i had paid for.
Then later, as this female staff was passing our table, a piece of receipt flew from her tray. Another customer was passing by and almost tripped as he tried to avoid it as it fluttered to the ground. She just looked at it on the floor, and continued on her way without picking it up. 😟
At least one of the managers was actually nice and helpful and tried to replace it again although the complaint was about the staff's behaviour.
Just also want to point out that not all the staff here is bad. Just one or two.. or three... that spoil the place.
author: Bren A

text: There is a few bad incident that I experienced here. The most I can't forget of is when I was waiting for my order for over 30 mins long during breakfast period. It was so crowded at that point of time. The managing was awful. The manager, a brown skin malay guy quite a big size build. (I do understand the language that he spoke in malay) he was talking among the team & it was clear enough to be heard. The remarks are " stupid people if cannot wait don't order" and he was giving a attitude that he don't bother to make things fast. The other incident i encounter, is that staff pretended to be busy when being called to & ignoring me. I have to call either one of the staff a few times just to get a extra sauce or some other things. But shout out to some chinese aunties that are working there, they are friendly.

text: McDonald's (Forum The Shopping Mall) has one of the worst management with no sense of urgency from my point of view! Received an order to pick up from the restaurant by Deliveroo! By the time travel to the restaurant to pick up the order is already past 15 minutes and order has not even started preparing! Waited another 10 minutes, order still not ready for collection for just 1 set of breakfast meal! For goodness sake, can you imagine this is food delivery (FAST FOOD) and what the staff is doing the whole time for the past 25 minutes? Even walk in customers order is faster than food delivery! End up, refused to wait any longer and cancel the order.

text:
Buying McDonald's nuggets due to chancing upon special promotional price. Of 20pc / $9.90, in a long while - 3 years ish.

Very poor service and knowledge from Bedok Reservoir outlet Manager Ms Jaslin on sauces policy when enquired on free sauces for 6/9 pcs. Uncertain with her guesses.

Be transparent and put up notices and prices inside restaurants and price lists. Don't hide information behind multiple pages and clicks or unknowgeable employees.

Btw, Manager Jaslin. The charging for sauces was not 2/3 years ago per her answer but 1yr ago on Jan 2025. Don't mislead your staff and customers - leaves a bad taste.
author: Dex Ter

text: We didnt get to order because the staff was extremely rude. I came with my child and planned to mobile order so we took a table closest to where the high chairs are. A staff approached us rudely and told us to move because we took a table for 4 when we were just 2. The store was literally empty. And i explained, though it was obvious, that i have a 2 yr old child with me. Anyway he kept on blabbering while i apologized many times like i did a crime. He helped us move to a 2 seat table but after a while i just decided to leave and find somewhere else to eat.
